evidence.quote: Firstly, a solution containing 1.5 M PbI2 and 7.5 mM RbCl in a DMF/DMSO solvent mixture ( v / v , 9/1) was spin-coated onto the PEDOT:PSS layer at 1500 rpm for 30 seconds, followed by annealing at 70 o C for 1 minute. Once the PbI2 layer reached room temperature, a mixture solution of FAI/MACl (90 mg/13.5 mg in 1 mL IPA) was spin-coated onto the PbI2 layer at 1800 rpm for 30 seconds. The resulting film was annealed at 150 o C for 30 minutes, leading to the formation of the FAPbI3 perovskite layer, which contained a small amount of (PbI2)2RbCl. [S3] UPS spectra were measured using an ESCALAB XI+ instrument (Thermo Fisher).

The chlorobenzene solution for an HTL was formulated with 40 mg mL -1 of p-O5H-E, p-O5H-E-POZ-E, p-POZ-E, PTAA, or 60 mg mL -1 of spiro-OMeTAD in combination with the mass content of 11% LiTFSI and 132 mM TBP. The gold electrode (~120 nm) was deposited using a shadow mask at a vacuum of  1  10 -4 Pa. The device size areas were 0.25 cm 2 . A waterproof adhesive tape (Kapton, 3M) was adhered to an unsealed PSC from the back. When measuring, a black metal mask (aperture area, 0.16 cm 2 ) was used to define the accurate active cell area.

The resulting film was annealed at 150 o C for 30 minutes, leading to the formation of the FAPbI3 perovskite layer, which contained a small amount of (PbI2)2RbCl. [S3] UPS spectra were measured using an ESCALAB XI+ instrument (Thermo Fisher).

The chlorobenzene solution for an HTL was formulated with 40 mg mL -1 of p-O5H-E, p-O5H-E-POZ-E, p-POZ-E, PTAA, or 60 mg mL -1 of spiro-OMeTAD in combination with the mass content of 11% LiTFSI and 132 mM TBP. A waterproof adhesive tape (Kapton, 3M) was adhered to an unsealed PSC from the back. When measuring, a black metal mask (aperture area, 0.16 cm 2 ) was used to define the accurate active cell area.

evidence.quote: Firstly, a solution containing 1.5 M PbI2 and 7.5 mM RbCl in a DMF/DMSO solvent mixture ( v / v , 9/1) was spin-coated onto the PEDOT:PSS layer at 1500 rpm for 30 seconds, followed by annealing at 70 o C for 1 minute. Once the PbI2 layer reached room temperature, a mixture solution of FAI/MACl (90 mg/13.5 mg in 1 mL IPA) was spin-coated onto the PbI2 layer at 1800 rpm for 30 seconds. The resulting film was annealed at 150 o C for 30 minutes, leading to the formation of the FAPbI3 perovskite layer, which contained a small amount of (PbI2)2RbCl. [S3] UPS spectra were measured using an ESCALAB XI+ instrument (Thermo Fisher).

Finally, we conducted operational stability assessments on solar cells employing pO5H-E-POZ-E and spiro-OMeTAD under simulated AM1.5G sunlight in a nitrogen atmosphere at 40  C. The tracking of maximum power points (MPPs) was performed using the standard perturb and observe method. The temporal evolutions of PCE (PCEMPP), photocurrent density ( J MPP), and photovoltage ( V MPP) at MPPs are presented in Figures 7A-7C. Over a duration of 500 h, the spiro-OMeTAD cell exhibited a significant decline of 25% in PCEMPP, attributed to a 21% decrease in J MPP and a 5% reduction in V MPP.
In contrast, after 500 h of tracking, the p-O5H-E-POZ-E cell's PCEMPP decreased from 24.3% to 23.9%, indicating an excellent retention rate of 98%, due to a 2% decline in J MPP.

evidence.quote: The p-O5H-E and p-POZ-E cells exhibited low PCEs below 21%; therefore, long-term thermal stability tests were conducted solely on the p-O5H-E-POZ-E, PTAA, and spiro-OMeTADcells. Six cells of each type were subjected to an 85  Covenfor a specific duration, followed by J -V measurements under AM1.5G conditions at room temperature. The temporal evolution of the average PCE was analyzed using a biexponential decay function (Figure 5A). After 1,000 h, the PCE of the p-O5H-E-POZ-E cells decreasedfrom an initial 24.9% to a final 23.2%, retaining 93% of its initial value. In comparison, the PTAA cells retained 78% of their initial PCE, while the spiro-OMeTAD cells only retained 25%.

unresolved_notes: The source states that the devices were measured in both reverse and forward scans, using reverse scan (1.2 V→0 V, step 0.005 V) and forward scan (0 V→1.2 V, step 0.005 V), but it does not identify the scan direction associated with the tabulated representative values, aged-cell values, or leading-cell annotations; those J-V observations therefore use scan_direction=not_reported.

The general J-V protocol used AM1.5G sunlight at 100 mW cm -2, but the schema has no observation-condition field. These protocol conditions were therefore not inserted as outcome metrics. The leading-cell caption independently confirms AM1.5G conditions with an irradiance of 100 mW cm -2.

The statement that the p-O5H-E-POZ-E forward and reverse J-V curves demonstrate minimal hysteresis does not identify an individual physical device or provide separate scan-specific outcomes, so it was not converted into an individual performance observation.

The representative steady-output cell, representative tabulated p-O5H-E-POZ-E cell, leading cell, EQE cell, and MPP-tracked cell are not explicitly established as the same physical device and remain separate records.

The representative cells measured after 1,000 h are not explicitly identified as particular members of the six-cell thermal-aging cohorts, so their J-V observations remain separate from the family-linked thermal tests.

The EQE passage reports shared ranges of 92%-94% and 24.9 to 25.3 mA cm − 2 for the coordinated set of p-O5H-E-POZ-E, p-POZ-E, PTAA, and spiro-OMeTAD cells. The shared quantities are preserved separately for each named cell type, but the source does not establish that these EQE measurements used the same physical devices as any tabulated representative or champion cells.

TBP was used in every HTL coating solution at 132 mM, but the source says a substantial fraction is expected to evaporate and only that residual traces may exist in complete cells. TBP is retained as a processing material rather than asserted as a finished-layer constituent.
The supplied evidence refers to section 3.6 for preparation of the ITO/SnO2 substrate but does not supply that section's fabrication details; no missing substrate-processing values were inferred.
The exact sample sizes of the initial photovoltaic-parameter distributions and humid-air cohorts are not reported in the supplied evidence.

The atmosphere, circuit condition, and encapsulation status of the 85 °C thermal-aging test are not established by the supplied evidence. The humid-air test establishes exposure to air at 85% relative humidity but does not report circuit condition, temperature, or encapsulation status.

The thermal-degradation characterization outcomes were obtained from unaged and aged PSCs, in some cases after detaching the gold electrode. The source does not explicitly establish that every EQE, optical-density, PL, XRD, and SEM specimen was one of the same six cells used to calculate the mean PCE trajectory; these outcomes are retained at family-linked thermal-test level without an individual-device link.

Characterization-only glass/FAPbI3/OSC films, OSC composite films, UPS specimens, MIS devices, hole-only devices, water-barrier specimens, nanoindentation films, and the glass/FAPbI3/PS/gold dummy cell were excluded because they were not established as complete photovoltaic devices.

The general J-V protocol reports AM1.5G illumination at 100 mW cm -2 and both reverse and forward scans, but the supplied evidence does not establish which scan direction produced each representative value in Table 1; no protocol-only performance observations were created.

Device size, mask aperture, and gold-electrode thickness are shared fabrication or measurement quantities rather than device-family identity changes. Existing specimen, layer, and processing records already carry these quantities, so no family replacements were made.
